ModMetaData.name: Interrupt Task
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Stops a pawn's current task without the draft and undraft dance.
- Works on colonists, slaves, children, and overseen colony mechs - Queued tasks stay queued - Leaves medical care, birth, deathrest, caravan forming, rituals, and quest work alone - Forced work asks before it stops - Bound to F by default, rebindable - Optional Goofy Mode renames the command to Sneeze and adds cosmetic sneeze text, puffs, and sound effects
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
